## Page content

Projects Writing Video Notes

Hi, I’m Max.

I live in London and work on bringing AI agents to procurement at TraDuotech.

My background is in industrial engineering, procurement, supply chain, product design and implementation.

I care about making AI agents useful in real work, with people staying in control.
